findings.supporting_action_evidence: Both episodes retain negative RL hip and positive RL knee base/conditional outputs; RR hip positive, RR knee negative. Conditional includes 0.9 observable HISTORY and must not all be called learned base mean. Real REQUEST differs from both conditional mean and unfiltered sample after limits.
findings.wheel_evidence: At both preterminal decisions nominal four wheel targets are zero but policy residual final targets are nonzero/differential in all four channels; this is recorded strategy output, not masking or missing N command.
findings.FR_sigma_scope: Only P06+ FR-knee stochastic innovation scale changed; sampled FR knee residuals near collision are modest positive 1.683/3.388 deg. Does not prove noise cured or identify sole failure cause.
findings.height_causality: Training audit has no body z/CoM height/collision-box vertical clearance at these samples. Joint differences and contact states do not prove which action lowered body or caused collision; no height reconstructed or fabricated.
findings.terminal_contact_caution: Episode0 terminal snapshot CONTACT_BEARING_UNVERIFIED reports all support false; do not infer a verified physical simultaneous loss of all contacts. Use preceding VERIFIED snapshot for load analysis.

claim_limits: Six selected decisions and two evolving-policy episodes do not justify changing action signs, support templates, reward, sigma, mapper, physical limits or the free-air qualification.
Three representative B frames describe a successful different trajectory, not a causal same-state intervention.
First episode briefly achieved actual RR free-air qualification then lost it before crossing; do not call qualification impossible, permanent, or completed traversal.
No all-channel mask/write loss observed in selected frames; unobserved times are not certified by this bounded review.
Do not assign optimizer credit beyond separately finalized rollout manifests.
